mentions.name: Teams Chat Exporter
mentions.description: Privacy-friendly open source browser extension that exports chats from the web client of Microsoft Teams, reaching about 90,000 users. Current work focuses on making exports of very large chats (containing several years of data) more stable while keeping them efficient and fast.
mentions.problem: Exporting huge Microsoft Teams chats spanning several years of data reliably and efficiently.
mentions.source_excerpt: Privacy friendly open source browser extension to export chats from web client of Microsoft Teams. Reached ~90000 users now. Currently working on making it more stable to export huge chats, which contains several years of data, while keeping things efficient and fast.

evidence.value: Privacy friendly open source browser extension to export chats from web client of Microsoft Teams. Reached ~90000 users now. Currently working on making it more stable to export huge chats, which contains several years of data, while keeping things efficient and fast.

mentions.name: Teams Chat Exporter
mentions.description: An open source browser extension that exports chats from the Microsoft Teams web client. It has reached more than 75,000 users in under a year, and development focuses on resolving issues reported by users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Today I resumed working on my open source browser extension to export chats from Microsoft Teams web client, after a two week long mandatory break due to busy dayjob activities. Now tackling the issues opened by users. Reached to more than 75000 users in less than a year, which makes me happy that its a useful thing.

Website is: https://teamschatexporter.com/
